modules.name: plugintest

modules.name: postgres
modules.summary: The official PostgreSQL store, safe development schema sync, and immutable production migration runner.

modules.name: mongodb
modules.summary: The official replica-set MongoDB store, additive development index synchronization, and immutable forward-only migration lifecycle.

modules.name: graphql

modules.name: mcp

modules.name: richtext
modules.summary: A paired, versioned Lexical field with authoring for portable content, references, uploads, and blocks.

modules.name: formbuilder
modules.summary: Payload-familiar dynamic form definitions, server-validated submissions, notifications, uploads, and payment callbacks.

modules.name: storage/local
modules.summary: Durable filesystem object storage for development and single-host deployments.

modules.name: storage/s3
modules.summary: Dependency-free S3-compatible object storage with SigV4 requests and signed private reads.

modules.summary: Reusable behavioral qualification suites for Ridu store adapters.
